commitments.promise_headline: FY24 Constant Currency Revenue Growth Guidance of 4.0% – 7.0%
commitments.promised_document: Infosys Q4 FY23 Earnings Conference Call Transcript
commitments.promised_quote: For the fiscal year 2024, our revenue growth guidance is 4% to 7% in constant currency terms.
commitments.delivered_document: Infosys Q4 FY24 Audited Financial Results and Press Release
commitments.delivered_quote: FY24 revenue growth was 1.9% in constant currency, impacted by slowdown in discretionary spending.
commitments.delivery_assessment: Missed lower boundary of original guidance by 2.1 percentage points as macro headwinds delayed enterprise client digital transformations in US & European BFSI.
commitments.management_explanation: Clients reprioritized budgets from discretionary digital transformation toward cost optimization and vendor consolidation.

commitments.promise_headline: Operating Margin Guidance Band of 20.0% – 22.0% for FY24
commitments.promised_by: Nilanjan Roy, Former Chief Financial Officer
commitments.promised_document: Infosys Q4 FY23 Financial Analyst Presentation
commitments.promised_quote: Operating margin for the fiscal year 2024 is expected to be in the range of 20% to 22%.
commitments.delivered_document: Infosys FY24 Annual Audited Standalone and Consolidated Results
commitments.delivered_quote: Operating margin for the full year FY24 stood at 20.6%, within our stated guidance band.
commitments.delivery_assessment: Delivered solidly inside the guided 20-22% margin corridor through Project Maximus cost optimization and disciplined pyramid rationalization.
commitments.management_explanation: Efficiency gains in sub-contractor rationalization and utilization improvements helped offset wage increments and macro pricing pressure.

commitments.promise_headline: Commitment to Return 85% of Cumulative Free Cash Flow Over 5-Year Cycle
commitments.promised_quote: The Board has decided to increase the capital return payout to approximately 85% of cumulative free cash flow over a 5-year period starting FY20.
commitments.delivered_document: Infosys Annual Report FY24 — Financial Review
commitments.delivered_quote: Cumulative capital return to shareholders across FY20-FY24 totaled ~86% of free cash flow via regular dividends and share buybacks.
commitments.delivery_assessment: Exceeded stated capital return policy target by returning ₹86,000+ Cr to shareholders across the 5-year window.
commitments.management_explanation: Consistent cash flow conversion supported generous dividend payouts along with completed open-market share buybacks.

commitments.promise_headline: Enterprise Generative AI Workforce Training of 100,000+ Engineers on Topaz
commitments.promised_document: Infosys Q1 FY24 Earnings Press Release & Concall
commitments.promised_quote: We have launched Infosys Topaz and committed to training over 100,000 employees in generative AI capabilities.
commitments.delivered_document: Infosys Q2 FY25 Media and Analyst Briefing
commitments.delivered_quote: Over 130,000 employees have now been certified in Generative AI technologies and prompt engineering.
commitments.delivery_assessment: Surpassed original headcount training target by 30% through mandatory Lex platform learning pathways.
commitments.management_explanation: Rapid adoption of internal GenAI assistants and developer accelerators boosted engineering participation.

commitments.promise_headline: Medium-Term Aspiration to Return to 26.0% – 28.0% Operating Margin Corridor
commitments.promised_document: TCS Q1 FY24 Earnings Call Transcript
commitments.promised_quote: Our aspiration remains firmly to operate in the 26% to 28% EBIT margin band as we optimize cost structures.
commitments.delivered_document: TCS Q4 FY24 Audited Financial Statement Press Release
commitments.delivered_quote: Q4 operating margin expanded to 26.0%, reaching the guided band, driven by disciplined productivity execution.
commitments.delivery_assessment: Met the threshold of the 26-28% target corridor in Q4 FY24 despite higher retention and cloud training expenses.
commitments.management_explanation: Strong sub-contractor cost reduction and improved realization in large deal ramp-ups enabled operating leverage.

commitments.promise_headline: Honoring 40,000 Fresh Campus Engineering Hiring Commitments for FY24
commitments.promised_by: Milind Lakkad, Chief Human Resources Officer
commitments.promised_document: TCS Q4 FY23 Media Conference Briefing
commitments.promised_quote: We will honor all 40,000 campus offers made for FY24 and continue our commitment to entry-level talent.
commitments.delivered_quote: During FY24, we welcomed 40,000+ campus recruits into TCS, completing our planned intake calendar.
commitments.delivery_assessment: Delivered as promised in an industry environment where many competitors delayed or paused fresher onboarding.
commitments.management_explanation: TCS maintained its long-term talent pyramid strategy rather than slowing intake due to short-term cyclical demand pauses.

commitments.promise_headline: Pan-India True 5G Standalone Network Rollout by December 2023
commitments.promised_document: Reliance Industries Limited 45th Annual General Meeting Speech
commitments.promised_quote: Jio will deliver True 5G to every town, every taluka, and every tehsil across our country by December 2023.
commitments.promised_locator: AGM Chairman's Address, Section: Digital Services
commitments.delivered_document: Reliance Industries Limited Q3 FY24 Earnings Presentation
commitments.delivered_quote: Jio has completed the fastest 5G rollout in the world, covering over 10,000 cities and towns ahead of schedule by end-2023.
commitments.delivery_assessment: Completed the world's fastest nationwide 5G SA deployment ahead of calendar deadline, deploying over 1 million 5G cells.
commitments.management_explanation: Indigenous 5G stack and massive small-cell fiber connectivity enabled acceleration of coverage milestones.

commitments.promise_headline: Value Unlocking Through Demerger and Public Listing of Jio Financial Services
commitments.promised_document: Reliance Industries Board Meeting Exchange Disclosure
commitments.promised_quote: The Board approved the Scheme of Arrangement for demerger of financial services business into Jio Financial Services Limited.
commitments.delivered_quote: Trading in equity shares of Jio Financial Services Limited (JIOFIN) commenced on NSE and BSE on August 21, 2023.
commitments.delivered_locator: Notice of Listing, BSE Scrip Code 543940
commitments.delivery_assessment: Successfully demerged and listed JIOFIN with a 1:1 share entitlement for all RIL shareholders.
commitments.management_explanation: All statutory and shareholder approvals received within the guided timeline, unlocking substantial value for parent investors.

commitments.promise_headline: Commissioning of Dhirubhai Ambani Green Energy Giga Complex Phase 1 in Jamnagar
commitments.promised_quote: Our Jamnagar complex will begin commissioning the first phase of solar photovoltaic giga-factory by the second half of 2024.
commitments.delivered_document: Reliance Industries Q2 FY25 Financial Disclosures
commitments.delivered_quote: Equipment installation is underway for the 20 GW solar PV manufacturing facility; commercial trial production commenced.
commitments.delivery_assessment: Construction on schedule with equipment trials initiated; full commercial production ramp-up expected in early 2025.
commitments.management_explanation: Modular fabrication and global technology partnerships kept execution within targeted capital spend envelopes.

commitments.promise_headline: Operational & Legal Merger Integration with HDFC Limited Effective July 2023
commitments.promised_document: HDFC Bank Q4 FY23 Media Conference
commitments.promised_quote: We anticipate all regulatory nods to be completed to enable merger effective date by July 1, 2023.
commitments.delivered_document: HDFC Bank Regulatory Disclosure to Stock Exchanges
commitments.delivered_quote: The composite scheme of amalgamation among HDFC Bank and HDFC Limited has become effective on July 1, 2023.
commitments.delivery_assessment: Completed the largest financial merger in Indian corporate history on the exact targeted timeline without service disruptions.
commitments.management_explanation: Coordinated execution across RBI, SEBI, CCI, and NCLT paved the way for seamless integration.

commitments.promise_headline: Loan-to-Deposit Ratio (LDR) Normalization Toward Historical Mid-80s Corridor
commitments.promised_document: HDFC Bank Q3 FY24 Analyst Earnings Call
commitments.promised_quote: Our strategy is to grow deposits significantly faster than advances to bring LDR down toward our historical 85-88% range over 3-4 years.
commitments.delivered_document: HDFC Bank Q2 FY25 Financial Results Press Release
commitments.delivered_quote: Deposits grew 15.1% YoY while advances grew 7.0%, bringing the LDR down to 99.8% from 110% at merger.
commitments.delivery_assessment: Progressing ahead of schedule; successfully brought post-merger LDR below the 100% psychological threshold within five quarters.
commitments.management_explanation: Deliberate slowing of corporate loan originations while leveraging branch network for retail deposit mobilization.

commitments.promise_headline: Opening 1,400+ New Retail Bank Branches in FY24 to Accelerate Deposit Franchise
commitments.promised_document: HDFC Bank Q4 FY23 Investor Presentation
commitments.promised_quote: We will continue branch expansion adding 1,400+ branches across semi-urban and rural centers in FY24.
commitments.delivered_document: HDFC Bank Q4 FY24 Earnings Press Release
commitments.delivered_quote: The bank opened 1,479 new branches during the fiscal year, expanding total network to 8,735 branches.
commitments.delivery_assessment: Exceeded annual branch expansion guidance by 79 branches, providing the physical foundation for deposit gathering.
commitments.management_explanation: Accelerated branch rollout in tier-2 and tier-3 markets to capture post-merger deposit synergies.
